title: Working Young: Jobs and Volunteering
text:
Many teenagers in Poland now look for part-time jobs during school holidays. Some work in cafés, while others help at local shops. Their earnings often pay for books, clothes or trips with friends.

Volunteering is another way for young people to gain experience. Last summer, a group of students spent two weeks cleaning a riverside park. Many of them said the work taught them patience and teamwork.

questions.text: Where do some teenagers work, according to the first paragraph?
How long did the students spend cleaning the riverside park?
Why might teenagers value part-time jobs, based on the first paragraph?
options: They want money for things they enjoy
They have no free time at all
They want to avoid their friends

questions.text: What do the students' comments suggest about the volunteer work?
options: It helped them grow as people
They did not enjoy working with others

vocabulary.definition: working fewer hours than a full working week
money that someone receives for work
working for free to help others
the ability to wait calmly without becoming upset

paragraph_translations: Wielu nastolatków w Polsce szuka teraz pracy dorywczej w czasie wakacji szkolnych. Niektórzy pracują w kawiarniach, a inni pomagają w lokalnych sklepach. Ich zarobki często pokrywają koszty książek, ubrań lub wyjazdów z przyjaciółmi.

Wolontariat to kolejny sposób, w jaki młodzi ludzie zdobywają doświadczenie. Ostatniego lata grupa uczniów spędziła dwa tygodnie na sprzątaniu parku nad rzeką. Wielu z nich mówiło, że ta praca nauczyła ich cierpliwości i pracy zespołowej.
